scenes.narration: Microduck learned to walk in a simulation before it ever took a real step.
scenes.on_screen_text: Learned to walk before step one
scenes.image_prompt: Photo-real medium shot of a calm Indian man about 35 presenting to camera in a bright home studio, relaxed curious expression, a small desk with a tiny robot model beside him, shallow depth of field.
scenes.speaker: Arjun

scenes.narration: Hugging Face's Microduck is a 25-centimetre walking robot, under 800 grams. Its CEO says it's heading for about 20,000 preorders.
scenes.image_prompt: Photo-real close-up of a small 25 cm bipedal robot standing on a workbench, soft studio light, a ruler beside it for scale, shallow depth of field.
scenes.speaker: Meera

scenes.narration: Fifteen motors, a camera, a depth sensor, and a beak that lifts about 100 grams. It walks, crouches, gets up after falls, and can even roller-skate.
scenes.image_prompt: Photo-real macro shot of a robotics engineer's hands adjusting small servo motors and wiring on a small robot frame in a bright lab, camera slowly pushing in.
scenes.speaker: Arjun

scenes.narration: So how? Reinforcement learning in a physics simulator. Fall, retry, improve. Then the skill transfers to the real robot. That's sim-to-real.
scenes.image_prompt: Photo-real over-the-shoulder shot of a developer at a dark desk watching a computer screen showing a simulated walking robot falling and getting back up, blue monitor glow.
scenes.speaker: Meera

scenes.narration: At Nvidia GTC Berlin, Jensen Huang demoed four live. They stumbled and wandered. Real floors are hard.
scenes.image_prompt: Photo-real wide shot of a tech conference stage with several small robots on a floor, one tipping over, audience silhouettes in the foreground, stage lighting.
scenes.speaker: Arjun

scenes.narration: The software is open source. The hardware designs aren't, according to Pollen.
scenes.image_prompt: Photo-real close-up of hands typing code on a laptop with a small robot kit blurred in the background, warm desk lamp light.
scenes.speaker: Meera

scenes.narration: $399 before tax and shipping. New orders: about four to six months. A 16-plus dev platform, not a toy.

scenes.speaker: Arjun
